origin: Read-only live PostgreSQL catalogs via connected Supabase; GitHub branch pinned
scope: Direct semantic review of the COMPLETE pg_depend edge identity/relationship metadata in stated ordinal ranges, NOT source re-review of underlying database functions/constraint definitions or native compiled implementations.

query_recipe.self_schema_sort: src_schema, src_type, object_description, ref_type, referenced_description, deptype
query_recipe.cross_schema_filter: src.schema IN ('public','private') AND ref.schema IN ('public','private','auth','storage','realtime') AND ref.schema<>src.schema
query_recipe.cross_schema_sort: src_schema, src_type, object_description, ref_type, referenced_description, deptype
query_recipe.hash_method: PostgreSQL md5 concatenating full schema, type, object, referenced schema, referenced object, dependency code (not hash of underlying object source)

provider_views.source_definition:
SELECT userid,
    dbid,
    toplevel,
    queryid,
    query,
    plans,
    total_plan_time,
    min_plan_time,
    max_plan_time,
    mean_plan_time,
    stddev_plan_time,
    calls,
    total_exec_time,
    min_exec_time,
    max_exec_time,
    mean_exec_time,
    stddev_exec_time,
    rows,
    shared_blks_hit,
    shared_blks_read,
    shared_blks_dirtied,
    shared_blks_written,
    local_blks_hit,
    local_blks_read,
    local_blks_dirtied,
    local_blks_written,
    temp_blks_read,
    temp_blks_written,
    shared_blk_read_time,
    shared_blk_write_time,
    local_blk_read_time,
    local_blk_write_time,
    temp_blk_read_time,
    temp_blk_write_time,
    wal_records,
    wal_fpi,
    wal_bytes,
    jit_functions,
    jit_generation_time,
    jit_inlining_count,
    jit_inlining_time,
    jit_optimization_count,
    jit_optimization_time,
    jit_emission_count,
    jit_emission_time,
    jit_deform_count,
    jit_deform_time,
    stats_since,

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_ddl_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  cmd record;
BEGIN
  FOR cmd IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_ddl_commands()
  LOOP
    IF cmd.command_tag IN (
      'CREATE SCHEMA', 'ALTER SCHEMA'
    , 'CREATE TABLE', 'CREATE TABLE AS', 'SELECT INTO', 'ALTER TABLE'
    , 'CREATE FOREIGN TABLE', 'ALTER FOREIGN TABLE'
    , 'CREATE VIEW', 'ALTER VIEW'
    , 'CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW', 'ALTER MATERIALIZED VIEW'
    , 'CREATE FUNCTION', 'ALTER FUNCTION'
    , 'CREATE TRIGGER'
    , 'CREATE TYPE', 'ALTER TYPE'
    , 'CREATE RULE'
    , 'COMMENT'
    )
    -- don't notify in case of CREATE TEMP table or other objects created on pg_temp
    AND cmd.schema_name is distinct from 'pg_temp'
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$
provider_event_triggers.verdict: PostgREST schema-cache invalidation for supported DDL tags; NOTIFY only.

provider_event_triggers.complete_source:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION extensions.pgrst_drop_watch()
 RETURNS event_trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE
  obj record;
BEGIN
  FOR obj IN SELECT * FROM pg_event_trigger_dropped_objects()
  LOOP
    IF obj.object_type IN (
      'schema'
    , 'table'
    , 'foreign table'
    , 'view'
    , 'materialized view'
    , 'function'
    , 'trigger'
    , 'type'
    , 'rule'
    )
    AND obj.is_temporary IS false -- no pg_temp objects
    THEN
      NOTIFY pgrst, 'reload schema';
    END IF;
  END LOOP;
END; $function$
provider_event_triggers.verdict: PostgREST schema-cache invalidation for non-temporary dropped objects; NOTIFY only.
